Abstract
# A Closer Look at Credit Ratings for CDOs
- • The interaction between the rating threshold and the structuring procedure can cause new issues to have tranches structured ”at the limit” of rating categories and thus a high probability of downgrading.

blocks.text: ∗The paper will be presented by Amal Moussa. Email: am2810@columbia.edu

Credit ratings assigned by rating agencies to structured credit products have played an important role in the development of the structured credit market, which has been cast into the limelight by the recent credit crisis. This study aims at clarifying some misconceptions related to CDO ratings, their interpretation and their use.
